what: B holds, beside Bo's signed case: an unsigned case under Ada's id and one under Bo's; a malformed row of Ada's naming no batch; a malformed row of Bo's naming his own batch, which does not list it; Ada's header H over a note and a malformed note; a row of Bo's naming H, which does not list it; and Ada's header over one seq listed twice. Merging B into A files each refusal where docs/format.md says and emits them by batch id (no id first), then code, then author id in hex: under no id, BATCH_UNSIGNED for Ada then Bo, then ROW_MALFORMED; under H, BATCH_DIGEST_MISMATCH (Bo) before ROW_MALFORMED (Ada); ROW_MALFORMED under Bo's batch; BATCH_SIGNATURE_INVALID under its own header.
